verdict.summary: The 20-root semantic object, exact RT13 projection, byte-bearing fixture universes, and D9-free LeaseStateV3 reducers independently rederive. The candidate is nevertheless rejected because the checker/verifier does not implement the closed authenticated dependency snapshot it declares: its retained EP8 adapter performs untracked path/pyc reads, and its asserted D9 consumer compatibility never executes the pinned D9 implementation.

blockingFindings.claimUnderTest: verifiedSemanticRtApiContract.frozenDependencySnapshotContract requires one alias-collapsed immutable byte map, exactly-one authenticated reads before source execution, in-memory source execution, no local path import, no nested content reread, and no pyc; returnedSnapshot retains a verified EP8 pure validation/derivation adapter.
blockingFindings.finding: FrozenAuthority authenticates twelve direct inputs, but the EP8 module it stores is not a closed in-memory adapter. Invoking its retained _ep7 dependency seam executes EP8's own path loader. An audit hook observed reads of evaluation-proof.v7.json, check-evaluation-proof-v7.py, and __pycache__/check-evaluation-proof-v7.cpython-314.pyc. None is in the RT15 frozen buffer map or read-count table, and the before/after read-count maps remained byte-for-byte equal. The no-path/no-pyc/read-once claim is therefore false for a callable the declared returned snapshot retains.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The verifier boundary is the authority that turns the declared pure surfaces into an implementable trusted snapshot. A callable that silently escapes to cwd-dependent files and pyc can execute bytes outside the authenticated snapshot while the checker still reports all inputs read once. This violates an explicit assigned acceptance criterion and prevents a freeze-grade VerifiedSemanticRTSnapshotV1 contract.
requiredRepair: Freeze the complete transitive EP8/RT13/D9/RT14 source-and-data closure into one alias-collapsed immutable buffer map before any source execution.

Compile every retained local module from those authenticated buffers through an in-memory local import map; local path loaders, sys.path discovery, pyc and nested content reads must be impossible, not merely absent on the checker's current happy path.

Construct and probe the actual opaque VerifiedSemanticRTSnapshotV1. Invoke every retained adapter with the filesystem path surface poisoned/closed, and make every observed content read participate in the exact read-count oracle.
Add mutation/falsifier coverage proving that an EP8 transitive path read, pyc read, second content read, alias swap, or cwd change cannot preserve a green result.

blockingFindings.claimUnderTest: verifiedD9Compatibility and the author adjudication claim that the exact frozen RT14 six call shapes and sixteen rows reproduce through accepted D9 v1.13 verifier evidence before the D9 capability is quarantined from the returned semantic snapshot.
blockingFindings.finding: The exact D9 checker is read and hash-pinned but is excluded from FrozenAuthority._execute_verified and is never retrieved from authority.modules. _d9_compatibility_findings AST-counts six expressions in the RT14 checker, then evaluates the rows with checker-local _d9_class and _d9_codes implementations plus a hard-coded precedence result. It never resolves or calls derive_class, derive_codes, V17.V16.derive_class, reduce_concurrent, or check on the pinned D9 v1.13 module.

activeProbe.description: In a TemporaryDirectory only, the D9 checker public exports derive_class, derive_codes, reduce_concurrent and V17 were made noncallable. The synthetic checker/review pins and matching candidate declaration were coherently updated so only runtime consumer sensitivity could reject. The RT15 normal checker still returned exit 0.
activeProbe.scopeNote: This falsifier does not allege that the exact reviewed D9 v1.13 bytes are defective. It proves that RT15's compatibility oracle is insensitive to the implementation/API it claims to consume.

blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A locally duplicated classifier can agree on the current golden rows while failing the exact consumer surface or future behavior of the pinned D9 module. This is the same producer-claims-producer pattern the architecture process forbids. The declared VerifiedD9SnapshotV1 constructor and six-call compatibility gate are not established.
requiredRepair: Build VerifiedD9SnapshotV1 from the exact authenticated D9 v1.13 checker buffer and its authenticated authority closure.
Derive the complete RT14 access/call surface from the frozen consumer and resolve every attribute chain, including V17.V16.derive_class, against the actual verified D9 module.
Execute all six call shapes and all 11 retained + 1 local + 4 contextual rows through the actual D9 functions; remove the local _d9_class/_d9_codes compatibility oracle.
Add runtime surface mutations for missing/noncallable exports and a sensitivity probe showing that changing pinned D9 behavior cannot remain green.

acceptanceResults.evidence: Exact 20-root order; 8 protected values recursively type/key-order/array-order/scalar-exact to RT13; 6 changed roots differ honestly; 5 legacy roots absent; 6 successor roots present. Status remains CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED/AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW.

dependencies.semanticSources is exactly EP8 + RT13. The semantic closure grammar, closure object, unit availability rows and availability fixtures project exactly from RT13. D9 v1.13 and rejected RT14 occur only in declared verifier-compatibility surfaces, not semantic dependencies or persisted lease/projection state.

Independent framing, unit-ID, Merkle-set commitment, canonical JSON, projection-ref and projection-digest oracles reproduce RT13's 23 refs / 2 units, 10606 canonical bytes, projection ref sha256:49a09580190c2f12de3912581171b3ed77dbd9c85a81c8367978a16016d16b60 and digest sha256:58c16d46dca070edb155ff8373973638b20f08877006f9a871306ed8b1a6afd3. Five independent generic vectors cover 11, 12, 13, 23 and 24 refs with 1, 3, 4, 2 and 5 units; permutations normalize identically and duplicate membership rejects.

All 12 embedded raw records strict-decode and byte-identically compact-reencode. Every request CAS, length, digest, result, dependency endpoint, proof ref, unit membership/ID, closure CAS/commitment, proof-bundle CAS, operational projection/ref/digest, snapshot, raw-byte commitment and fixture commitment independently rederive from embedded bytes. Primary is 7 refs / 2 units / 8 edges; alternate is 5 / 3 / 5. There are zero identity-only terminals and no fixture CAS equals any of the 11 unavailable patterned RT13 identities.

The reviewed RT15 bytes contain a complete new exact-byte universe for each fixture: every raw proof requirement and dependency endpoint resolves to one embedded byte vector, and the enclosing closure/proof/projection bytes and identities are included. A future Evidence v9 successor can pin the exact reviewed RT15 subject and fixture snapshot/result, rebuild its own enclosing Evidence values, and undergo fresh review. This does not recover, replace, or validate the old RT13 NOMATCH closure or any of its 11 unavailable patterned preimages.

An independently implemented D9-free LeaseStateV3 model reproduces 9/9 embedded scenarios. Exact fresh/idempotent/refusal semantics, expiry deferral, full ordered pending application on release/reclaim, crash successor fence old+1, durable fence advancement, state preservation on refusal, and the eight closed result variants hold. The candidate adds no v3 purge reducer or store/receipt/E8/E9/HostTermination backedge.

The blind oracle selftest passed 44 checks including 28 malformed reducer calls. The authored checker normal mode passed; its selftest rejected 40 exact candidate mutations, 132 raw-resolution adversarials, 36 lease-shape adversarials and 48 hostile shapes, with a generated 9/4 fixture. These results establish only the inspected paths and do not cure the two verifier-boundary falsifiers.

nonBlockingObservations.text: The embedded checker-generated proof bundle is deliberately not asserted to be an EP8 EvaluationProofBundleV5. A future Evidence v9 successor must consume the reviewed byte fixture as upstream test data and rebuild its own closed Evidence/EP values; it must not relabel the fixture-only bundle as an admitted production EP8 bundle.

Several fixture-only domain separators and snapshot/fixture commitment equations are executable in the checker but summarized rather than fully enumerated in the JSON artifact. This did not prevent independent recomputation from the exact frozen pair, but a successor repair should promote those equations into the binding artifact so a Rust implementer need not reverse-map Python helper bodies.
